content:
Create a highly photorealistic cinematic character sheet of an 18-year-old young man from a grounded medieval fantasy world. He has a slim, athletic build, warm medium-brown skin, long messy black hair, striking green eyes and youthful but defined facial features. His expression should feel serious, brave, curious and determined.

The composition is divided into three perfectly equal vertical sections, each occupying exactly 33.33% of the image:

LEFT SECTION — close-up portrait from the chest upward, facing directly forward and looking straight into the camera. Show his facial features in high detail: green eyes, long black hair, medium-brown skin, natural pores, subtle freckles, small scratches and slight traces of dirt.

CENTER SECTION — full-body front view, completely visible from head to feet, centered within the section, standing in a neutral natural pose and looking directly at the camera. Clearly show his body proportions, silhouette and complete outfit.

RIGHT SECTION — full-body back view, completely visible from head to feet, showing the rear construction of the clothing, long hairstyle, belt, sandals and overall silhouette. Keep the character fully consistent across all three views.

He wears lightweight handmade medieval fantasy clothing suitable for a warm climate: a sleeveless rough linen tunic, simple layered fabric, a worn brown leather belt, lightweight trousers, subtle leg wraps, brown leather sandals and a small leather belt pouch. The clothing should look asymmetrical, handmade, slightly worn, dusty and constructed from linen, cotton, leather, cord and natural materials.

No modern objects, no logos, no armor, no weapons, no magic effects and no exaggerated fantasy features.

Neutral medium-gray seamless studio background, professional studio lighting, soft cinematic illumination, subtle contact shadows beneath the full-body views, clean character-sheet presentation, highly photorealistic textures, realistic skin, hair, fabric and leather, consistent character proportions and clothing across all three views.

Tiene una complexión delgada y atlética, piel moreno medio cálida, cabello negro largo y despeinado, llamativos ojos verdes y rasgos faciales juveniles pero definidos. Su expresión debe transmitir seriedad, valentía, curiosidad y determinación.

La composición se divide en tres secciones verticales perfectamente iguales, cada una ocupando exactamente el 33,33% de la imagen:

SECCIÓN IZQUIERDA — retrato en primer plano desde el pecho hacia arriba, de frente y mirando directamente a la cámara. Muestra sus rasgos faciales con gran detalle: ojos verdes, cabello negro largo, piel moreno medio, poros naturales, pecas sutiles, pequeñas raspaduras y leves rastros de suciedad.

SECCIÓN CENTRAL — vista frontal de cuerpo completo, completamente visible de la cabeza a los pies, centrado dentro de la sección, de pie en una pose natural neutra y mirando directamente a la cámara. Muestra claramente sus proporciones corporales, silueta y atuendo completo.

La ropa debe verse asimétrica, artesanal, ligeramente gastada, polvorienta y construida con lino, algodón, cuero, cordón y materiales naturales.

Sin objetos modernos, sin logotipos, sin armadura, sin armas, sin efectos mágicos y sin rasgos de fantasía exagerados.
